claims.label: AVOIDABLE_REDUNDANCY

claims.reason: The DOM already identifies the shirt as having buttons and contrast buttons, but repeating buttons is necessary to anchor the novel facts that they are black and arranged down the center front of the shirt.

claims.reason: The DOM explicitly identifies the garment as having long sleeves in the title and structured sleeve attributes. Repeating this information adds no new visual grounding.

claims.reason: The DOM identifies cuffs and their style but does not specify that they are narrow. Repeating cuffs and their position at the sleeve ends is necessary to ground the novel narrowness attribute to the correct garment component.
